versionRationale: Initial independent authored outcomes and immutable text fixture; empty member migration closes a discovered persistence gap. No expected-output snapshot rewrite.

rights.provenance: Project-authored synthetic support/empty TXT and CLI assertions. No external dataset or credentials.

cases.R01-A01: Success without framework/Python/model services; exact source citation resolves before revoke.
cases.LOCAL-TEXT-WALKTHROUGH: upload -> leased job -> validate -> activate -> search -> fresh disclosure -> original citation read -> revoke -> denied.
cases.MALFORMED-COMMAND: Exit 2 before host callback; no echoed input, credentials, paths or duplicate JSON keys.
cases.DENIED: Denied exit 3 and no document data, including an upload denied before resource writes.
cases.REPEAT-UPLOAD: Identical upload/key/expected state replays exact metadata with no new version/resource; changed request conflicts.
cases.EMPTY: An unmatched query and a published confirmed-empty TXT return empty/data=[]/exit 0.
cases.REVOKE-CACHE-DISCLOSURE: Actual cache hit issues a new selection; revoke then new attempt returns denied without Usage/text; old attempt metadata only.
cases.OUTPUT-REDACTION: One JSON envelope on stdout, safe stderr; unexpected errors exit 70 with no exception text/credentials/paths.
cases.CLI-GRAMMAR: Every approved CLI route validates a closed input and forwards typed mutation flags to the host.
cases.TYPED-OUTCOMES: success/empty=0, denied=3, unknown/unavailable=4, incompatible=5, syntax=2, unexpected=70.
cases.EXACT-SCOPE-IDENTITY: Foreign tenant/token/tampered exact refs cannot disclose; historical citation does not redirect to a new empty version.
cases.CANCEL-FENCING: Stale epoch fails; cancellation fences the worker and prevents late publication.
cases.LIFECYCLE-COMMANDS: Correction denies historical bytes; legal hold prevents physical completion while deletion task metadata stays pending.
cases.EMPTY-MEMBER-INVARIANT: A sealed catalog-bound empty member can publish; a nonempty chunkset with missing projection cannot masquerade as empty.
cases.FIXTURE-INTEGRITY: Digests, provenance, donor decisions and candidate receipt match.
cases.RUNNER-NEGATIVES: Missing, skipped, failing and zero cases, unknown group and failed child all fail closed.
